body: I support the development of a smart lock system - for sure. Any insight on costs?
this is a good project for Sascha and the team at IOTA to play around with too.

Bumping this for [@drewstone](/edgeware/account/hwR8hAatmmdupBLXQSxLUPBa8GhRomLD9hf6iRtFeXs8fcY), we can almost certainly get the precompiles in!

[@cameron](/edgeware/account/iyDRREzJqZJEb12VqLwB6Q8h8wdc1YnZQMWGTgubjzGdYeJ) and [@Thom Ivy](/edgeware/account/jKauGVPCQkteGTDKuuNwhYhMBrj5QuytgybEC4A5cS4Bki5) is there a longer proposal we should put together to make the prop for an EDGPort + NFC smart door locks a reality?

Let's do it!!!

Reviving...ironically in my previous life I made smart door locks, so NFC readers on doors is eerily familiar :)

All of these are super cool. A technical request: a native precompile for ECDSA P256 (instead of the classic secp256k1) would make this insanely straightforward to pull off.

[@cameron](/edgeware/account/iyDRREzJqZJEb12VqLwB6Q8h8wdc1YnZQMWGTgubjzGdYeJ) that would be super insanely cool. If we: 

1) had NFC / readers on doors / EDGPorts
2) tied this to EDG verified identities
3) Kong.cash or kong.land, type interactions if I am able to guess what Cameron is actually thinking about ahaha
4) had some type of "membership / citizenship tax" where (staking towards some kind of EDGPort) validator was enough.

This is fantastic -- as [@dillchen](/edgeware/account/hcgMhR61jUS55naSR5uW4JjN92zdFp3V91TtSCJmdnuxZAL) noted, we're also super interested in the physical/digital boundary of crypto and have been heads down building easy, secure hardware to enable interactions in spaces like this via kong.cash and soon kong.land. EDGPort passports?

This is very cool, some related thoughts would be the Balaji piece which [@mrbulb](/edgeware/account/jXC7ghviUzVcVySg3eD8prB7C9m6VzK6cw2MTyMTDTUye5q) previously shared as well as the exciting work that [http://kong.land/](http://kong.land/) and [http://kong.cash/](http://kong.cash/) are doing.
